{{Short description|Mathematical conjecture}}
In [[mathematics]], the '''determinantal conjecture''' of {{harvs|txt|last=Marcus|year=1972}} and {{harvs|txt|last=de Oliveira|year=1982}} asks whether the [[determinant]] of a sum ''A''&nbsp;+&nbsp;''B'' of two ''n''-by-''n'' [[Normal matrix|normal]] [[complex number|complex]] [[matrix (mathematics)|matrices]] ''A'' and ''B'' lies in the [[convex hull]] of the ''n''! points Π<sub>''i''</sub> (''λ''(''A'')<sub>''i''</sub>&nbsp;+&nbsp;''λ''(''B'')<sub>''σ''(''i'')</sub>), where the numbers ''λ''(''A'')<sub>''i''</sub> and ''λ''(''B'')<sub>''i''</sub> are the [[eigenvalue]]s of ''A'' and ''B'', and ''σ'' is an element of the [[symmetric group]] ''S<sub>n</sub>''.
